meta.title: Withdraw is offered on an upcoming RFQ
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared upcoming RFQ event's summary page.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Navigate to the RFQ stage page where its Settings menu is available.
Assert that Withdraw is offered and clickable in the upcoming RFQ's Settings menu.
Open the withdrawal confirmation window without confirming the withdrawal.
Assert that the withdrawal window opened and presents the remarks field.
Assert that the confirmation window provides a Cancel action.
Cancel the withdrawal so the event remains unchanged.
Assert that the withdrawal window closed after cancellation.
